property_summary: For any input, C.transferFrom must return the boolean value actually returned by the underlying share token's transferFrom (even when that call succeeds but returns false), not the raw low-level success flag; the mutant returns true whenever the call merely succeeds, breaking the rule when the token returns false without reverting.
change_summary: Return the success flag of the low-level call instead of decoding the token's returned boolean, which can differ when the call succeeds but returns false.
